Guard against degenerate input\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    if (bins == 0) return {};\n    if (data.empty()) return std::vector<std::uint64_t>(bins, 0);\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 2. Compute global minimum and maximum in parallel\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Use a pair {min, max} as the reduction value.\n    using minmax_pair = std::pair<double, double>;\n\n    auto minmax_op = [](minmax_pair const& a, minmax_pair const& b) -> minmax_pair\n    {\n        return { std::min(a.first,  b.first),\n                 std::max(a.second, b.second) };\n    };\n\n    // Initial value: (+inf, -inf)\n    const minmax_pair init{ std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(),\n                            -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity() };\n\n    const minmax_pair global = hpx::parallel::reduce(\n        hpx::execution::par,               // parallel execution policy\n        data.begin(), data.end(),\n        init,\n        minmax_op,\n        // projection: turn a double into a {value,value} pair\n        [](double v) -> minmax_pair { return { v, v }; });\n\n    const double data_min = global.first;\n    const double data_max = global.second;\n\n    // If all values are identical we place everything in the first bucket.\n    const double range = (data_max > data_min) ? Allocate atomic counters for each bucket\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    std::vector<std::atomic<std::uint64_t>> atomic_hist(bins);\n    for (auto& a : atomic_hist) a.store(0, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n\n    // ----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // 4.          // f = g + h\n        double g;          // cost from start to this vertex\n        std::size_t v;     // vertex id\n\n        // priority_queue is a max‑heap, therefore we invert the comparison\n        bool operator<(Node const& o) const { return f > o.f; }\n    };\n\n    std::priority_queue<Node> open;          // frontier (min‑heap on f)\n    std::mutex open_mtx;                     // protects `open`\n\n    std::vector<std::atomic<double>> g_score(N);   // best g‑value seen so far\n    for (auto& a : g_score) a.store(INF, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n    g_score[start].store(0.0, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n\n    std::vector<std::size_t> came_from(N, N); // N works as “undefined”\n\n    std::atomic<bool> finished{false};       // true as soon as goal is popped\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Insert the start node\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    {\n        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(open_mtx);\n        open.emplace(Node{heuristic[start], 0.0, start});\n    }\n\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Worker function – each HPX thread executes this lambda\n    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------\n    auto worker = [&]() mutable\n    {\n        while (!finished.load(std::memory_order_acquire))\n        {\n            Node cur;\n\n            // --------------------------------------------------------------\n            // 1) pop the best node from the shared priority queue\n            // --------------------------------------------------------------\n            {\n                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(open_mtx);\n                if (open.empty())\n                    break;  // cost from start to this node\n        std::size_t          v;       // vertex id\n        std::size_t          parent;  // predecessor (only for reconstruction)\n        bool operator>(PQNode std::atomic<bool> goal_found{false};\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    //  Initialise\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------\n    g_score[start].store(0.0, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n    parent[start].store(start, std::memory_order_relaxed);\n    {\n
